source.unsupportedBrowser: This browser cannot reach Bluetooth devices. Use Chrome or Edge.

table.title: Data
table.empty: No data yet. Press Record to start.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows a live count-rate readout, a chart of the count rate over time, and a table of the measurements collected so far.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area lets you choose a counting source, set the counting interval and run length, start and stop recording, export the data, and reset the simulation.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Press Record to collect a run of measurements, then read the count rate and the table.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows a histogram of the collected measurements, with optional Poisson and Gaussian curves drawn on top, alongside a panel of summary statistics.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area lets you choose a counting source, set the counting interval and run length, start and stop recording, choose which theoretical curves to show, set the histogram bin width, export the data, and reset the simulation.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Collect a run of measurements, then compare the histogram against the Poisson and Gaussian curves.

preferences.title: Simulation
preferences.showDiagnosticsDescription: Adds the raw count register and GM tube voltage to the source panel, for checking how a connected counter reports its counts.
preferences.beepEnabledDescription: When unchecked, silences the audible count indicator on a connected PASCO Wireless Geiger Counter.
preferences.tubeVoltageDescription: Bias applied to a connected counter's G-M tube. Use a plateau experiment to explore how count rate depends on voltage.
